affected_projects.to: A proposed data center development called the 'Union County Campus' in El Dorado, tied to Paradox Data LLC. On June 25, 2026, Fort Lauderdale-based Z Squared Inc. announced a binding letter of intent to acquire a majority ownership interest in Paradox Data LLC; per SEC filings, the transaction had not closed as of the reporting reviewed. The site has an existing 8-MW utility connection, a roughly 10-acre parcel under a binding purchase contract, and company documents describing a potential campus of up to 170 acres and a long-term target of as much as 150 MW combining utility power and on-site natural-gas generation. The June 30, 2026 emergency Quorum Court meeting that adopted the moratorium was held amid heavy public interest in this proposal.
affected_projects.reason: South Arkansas Now's full report on the June 30, 2026 vote (which it livestreamed) identifies a specific, named pending proposal -- the Union County Campus / Paradox Data LLC transaction -- discussed at the meeting that adopted the moratorium.
